name: Dalim
source:
A servant who has been taking care of the Earl since childhood. He can't
speak the language well, but he can communicate with the Earl. He's a gentle young man with a quiet demeanor.

[Translated from [url=http://erfolg.main.jp/project/muh/]ERFOLG's official website[/url]]
